title: Yellow Tangy Ukrainian Apricot Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish with a tangy twist, featuring apricot jam and a lacquer glaze, perfect for a rainy day. This plant-based friendly recipe is a must try for anyone looking for a unique dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and melted vegan butter to form a dough.
Gradually add the plant-based milk, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla extract to the dough, mixing until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of apricot jam in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the jam to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with lacquer glaze.
Bake the dumplings for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings warm, garnished with additional apricot jam if desired.
